title: There be 句型
intro: 8 页互动精讲：There is / There are · 就近原则 · 描述某地有某物 · PSLE 完形/填空高频
psleNote: Set 01 完形 There are so many people、多道 there is/are 考点，共 17 处真题关联。

examples.en: There are so many people in the shopping centre.
examples.zh: 购物中心里有这么多人。

examples.en: There is a new library near our school.
examples.zh: 我们学校附近有一座新图书馆。

examples.en: There are two books on the desk.
There is some milk in the fridge.
There isn't any water in the bottle.
Are there any apples on the table?
There was a big sale in the shop yesterday.
There will be a school trip next month.
examples.zh: 下个月有一次学校郊游。

pages.title: 听一听 · 购物中心
pages.audio: There are so many people in the shopping centre.
pages.soundHint: 这句话在描述什么？人在哪里？
pages.question: 这是在说「某地有某物/某人」吗？
pages.sentence: There are so many people in the shopping centre.
pages.zh: 购物中心里有这么多人。

pages.title: 苏格拉底 · is 还是 are？
pages.question: 为什么 people 前面用 are 而不是 is？

choices.text: 因为 people 是复数意义
choices.fb: 对了！people 表「人们」，谓语用 are。

choices.text: 因为 shopping centre 是复数
choices.fb: shopping centre 是单数，但 there be 看后面紧跟的名词。

choices.text: 因为 many 后面永远用 are
choices.fb: 关键看 many people 是复数。

pages.sentence: There are so many people in the shopping centre.
pages.zh: 购物中心里有这么多人。

pages.title: 规则发现 · There is vs There are
pages.lead: 点击卡片听例句，发现 is 和 are 怎么选。
pages.leftSentence: There is a book on the desk.
pages.rightSentence: There are two books on the desk.
pages.discovery: There be 看后面名词：单数/不可数用 is；复数用 are。

pages.title: 配对 · is 还是 are？
pages.lead: 看主语，选出正确的 There is 或 There are。

chart.subjects: a book / some milk / a cat
two books / many people / three dogs

drill.subject: a new library near our school
drill.sentence: There is a new library near our school.
drill.zh: 我们学校附近有一座新图书馆。

drill.subject: so many people in the mall
drill.sentence: There are so many people in the shopping centre.

drill.subject: some milk in the fridge
drill.sentence: There is some milk in the fridge.

pages.title: 规则卡 · There be 句型
pages.lead: 描述存在：There + be + 名词 + 地点。

rules.rule: There is + 单数/不可数；There are + 复数
rules.sample: There are two books on the desk.

rules.rule: There isn't / There aren't；Is there…? Are there…?
rules.sample: There isn't any water in the bottle.

pages.title: 限时快选 · PSLE 真题
pages.q: There _____ so many people in the shopping centre.
pages.hint: many people 是复数，用 There are。
pages.sentence: There are so many people in the shopping centre.
pages.zh: 购物中心里有这么多人。

pages.title: 听音排序 · There be 句
pages.audio: There is a new library near our school.
pages.sentence: There is a new library near our school.
pages.zh: 我们学校附近有一座新图书馆。

pages.title: 写作句框 · There be 口诀
checklist: 描述存在：There is/are + 名词 + 地点状语
单数/不可数 → is；复数 → are
写作：There is a park near my home. There are many trees in it.
否定：There isn't any… / There aren't any…
pages.chant: There is, there are — place has something! Singular is, plural are — easy!
pages.chantSpeak: There is, there are, place has something! Singular is, plural are, easy!
